title: Anyone willing to test out a multiplayer RC car racing game?
author: geddy
selftext:
Hey everyone, I've been working on this for a few weeks and am happy with where it's gone so far. In short it's a realistic RC car racing game, built so I could enjoy my favorite hobby from the comfort of home (turns out having kids limits the amount of time you can spend racing toy cars..lol).

At the moment I'm working on tweaking netcode to make it run more stable. I've got the server populated with some sims but the tougher thing to simulate is users from all over the world.

I'm looking for feedback in general, but most specifically, the stability during the race.

I've been lurking on this sub for a few weeks so I hope this doesn't violate any rules - the game is self-hosted and will always be free. Again this is a work of passion seeing how far I can push Sonnet 5 to make the most realistic racing experience possible.

To play with the track editor, save presets, or design custom bodies, you need an account, but it doesn't require any personal data or an email. Just give it a name and make up a password.

Looking forward to hearing any and all comments, if you check it out I'm already thrilled that you were willing to look at it, comment or not!

[https://race.leecasita.com/](https://race.leecasita.com/)

replies.body: It supports both gamepads and also RC transmitters, which is the best way to play (either or) - but it's possible you had less than optimal tire selection for the terrain or track condition. Can you go into detail about what you didn't like about the POV? Did you try switching the camera (press C) to drone follow or FPV?
